categories.main_business_segments: Shiyue Daotian Group primarily operates in the pantry staple food industry, focusing on pre-packaged premium rice, corn, whole grain, bean, and dried food products. The company manages multiple well-recognized brands including Shiyue Daotian, Firewood Courtyard, and Sunshine Family, with rice and corn products constituting the major revenue sources.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs highly standardized and automated production processes, investing substantially in advanced machinery and equipment. It maintains vertically integrated operations covering procurement, storage, production, sales, and logistics, ensuring freshness and quality. Production bases are strategically located in core grain-producing areas in Northeast China and Inner Mongolia, with advanced warehousing facilities preserving freshness under low-temperature conditions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shiyue Daotian serves both corporate and individual customers, including catering companies, agricultural product companies, and end consumers. Its sales network spans online e-commerce platforms, self-operated online stores, modern retail channels, direct customers, and distribution networks, targeting the Chinese domestic market with a focus on health-conscious consumers seeking quality and convenience.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Mainland China, with production bases in Northeast China and Inner Mongolia, and sales offices in Beijing and Hong Kong. It has established regional distribution centers in Shanghai, Tianjin, Chengdu, Shenyang, and Dongguan, supporting nationwide distribution and sales coverage.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shiyue Daotian operates a vertically integrated supply chain encompassing upstream procurement of raw grains, midstream processing and production, and downstream sales and distribution. The company controls the entire value chain from field to table, including planting, procurement, order-based production, processing, warehousing, logistics, and retail sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in pantry food categories, optimizing product portfolios towards mid to high-end rice and expanding corn as a second growth pillar. It focuses on omni-channel sales expansion, brand building through IP and marketing, and deepening supply chain integration to enhance operational efficiency and product quality. The company also aligns with national policies on modern mega-agriculture and rural revitalization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pre-packaged pantry staple food products, including rice, corn, whole grain, bean, and dried food products. Sales are conducted via multiple channels including e-commerce platforms, self-operated online stores, modern retail outlets, direct corporate customers, and distribution networks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shiyue Daotian is recognized as a leading and rapidly growing pantry food company in China, holding top market positions such as the 'Top Selling Brand for Northeast Rice in China for Five Consecutive Years' and 'Top Selling Brand for Corn Categories in China' according to Frost & Sullivan. It competes in a mature and stable market with a focus on premium and health-oriented products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group recorded revenue of RMB 5,745.3 million, an 18.0% increase from 2023, and an adjusted net profit of RMB 349.5 million, a 115.5% increase year-on-year. The gross profit margin improved significantly from 12.7% to 17.7%, reflecting enhanced earnings quality. The company has a gearing ratio of 23.0% as of December 31, 2024, down from 28.5% in 2023, indicating a healthy financial position and growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shiyue Daotian emphasizes providing Chinese consumers with healthy, high-quality, and safe pantry food products. Its competitive differentiation lies in product innovation, premium product mix focusing on mid to high-end rice and corn, a vertically integrated supply chain ensuring freshness and quality, and a robust omni-channel sales network that enhances consumer accessibility and brand recognition.
